svg.title: Trajectory — from operations to full-stack development and applied AI
svg.desc: Step 01 OPERATIONS: 7+ yrs · 4 companies admin · ops · customers. Step 02 DAW · UOC: last semester grade average 9.29 / 10. Step 03 FULL-STACK: backend · frontend devops. Step 03 APPLIED AI: agents · automation prompt design. Step 04 GOAL: practical, scalable, well-structured solutions
svg.text: operations → daw → full-stack + applied ai → goal
